'''Darth Revan's robes''' were aptly named for being the usual [[Sith apparel|wear]] of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] during [[Gender/Legends|his]] time as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], though they were destroyed when he was captured by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] viewed his [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] as an abomination.<ref name="KOTOR" />

The robes were created by a mystical technology of the [[Star Forge]] in a way to fuel the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energies of the wearer through the garments to strengthen him.<ref name="KOTOR" />

The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], as well as mind-wiped Revan, were unaware that such an item of terrible power could be possibly created by the Star Forge for the second time.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
If the player chooses the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] path, they receive a pair of robes on the [[Star Forge]] very similar to the original guise instead of the [[Star Forge Robe]]. These robes can be worn only by Jedi characters who have a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] alignment. The wearer receives Strength bonus and an ability to regenerate 1 health point every 5 seconds.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Although it is stated that the robes were created by the Star Forge, Revan is shown wearing them on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], whilst unearthing the [[Star Map]] in the [[Rakatan ruins (Dantooine)|ancient ruins]] there, ''before'' he discovered the Star Forge's [[Lehon system|location]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

Revan is seen wearing similar robes on the front cover of ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', despite turning back to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light side of the Force]] as of the story's timeline.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>
